metadata.title: Premarket movers: Several tech stocks bounce back while Oracle slumps; Intel gets an upgrade - MarketWatch

content.text:
4 days ago
Premarket movers: Several tech stocks bounce back while Oracle slumps; Intel gets an upgrade
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Thursday's premarket action:
Shares in Oracle have fallen by about 8% driven by the software company's reporting of higher-than-expected capital expenditures.
Super Micro Computer's stock is up more than 6% after plunging by almost 30% on the announcement of a $7 billion equity and equity-linked financing package – potentially an indication of investors buying the dip.
Micron has risen by 3% as tech stocks rebounded before the final pricing of SpaceX's IPO later on Thursday. Rival semiconductor companies Nvidia and Broadcom also climbed higher.
Intel shares gained 5% as Bank of America moved its rating up by two notches, to buy from underperform, and increased its price target to $135.
